sentences.text: South Access Scanner serves the designated southern entry route to the offshore wind farm.
The route is intended for personnel arriving through the south-side access point.
Its location and operating hours are defined in the site access plan.
The scanner applies the same identity verification standard used at other controlled entry points.
Each entrant presents an individually assigned credential for validation.
The scanner checks that the credential is active and belongs to the person presenting it.
Access is granted only when the person has current authorization for the requested area and time.
The route does not provide an alternate way to bypass work authorization or site restrictions.
The scanner records each successful entry and each denied attempt with a time reference.
The record supports routine review of access activity and investigation of anomalies.
A local visual indicator communicates whether entry is permitted or denied.
The entry barrier remains closed when validation fails or the scanner cannot complete a check.
Personnel must not hold the barrier open for another entrant.
Anti-tailgating measures are applied at the southern entry point.
Visitors and temporary personnel follow the same identity checks as other entrants.
Any escort requirement is verified before access is granted.
The route is kept physically separated from areas that are not authorized for general access.
Signs identify the permitted approach and direct personnel to the controlled entry point.
The installation team verifies the scanner, barrier, and communications before the route is placed in service.
Routine checks confirm that credential readers, indicators, and barrier controls operate as intended.
Faults are reported promptly, and the route is placed out of service if secure operation cannot be assured.
When the scanner is unavailable, personnel use an approved alternative entry process rather than an uncontrolled bypass.
Emergency egress remains available without requiring an access credential from the inside of the route.
Changes to the southern route are reviewed under the same change-control process as other access rules.
